**Notes/Observations**:

-   Filtering
    -   Biallelic SNPs only
    -   Phred score greater than/equal to 30
    -   Depth of greater than or equal to 3 reads
    -   Sites not missing more than 30% of individuals
    -   Minor allele frequency of 1-5%
